info.title: Mini HRM API
info.description: No commercial plan limits. Human presentation uses dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss (UTC+7); transport remains ISO/UTC. Bearer authentication; tenant resolved from membership. All money uses integer VND. Payroll is a non-statutory estimate. See docs/API.md for workflow payloads.
